name: pi-child-agent
description: Native Windows-friendly child-agent workflow extension for Pi. Spawn isolated worker agents for code audit, delegated tasks, and sub-process management.

scripts.test: tsx tests/test-extension.ts && tsx tests/windows-native-smoke.ts && tsx tests/phase2-hardening.ts && tsx tests/crash-recovery.ts
scripts.test:fast: tsx tests/test-extension.ts && tsx tests/windows-native-smoke.ts && tsx tests/live-workflow.ts && tsx tests/container-smoke.ts
scripts.test:full: tsx tests/test-extension.ts && tsx tests/windows-native-smoke.ts && tsx tests/phase2-hardening.ts && tsx tests/crash-recovery.ts && tsx tests/live-workflow.ts && tsx tests/container-smoke.ts
scripts.test:ci:windows: tsx scripts/validate-tools.ts && tsx scripts/doctor.ts && tsx tests/test-extension.ts && tsx tests/windows-native-smoke.ts && tsx tests/phase2-hardening.ts && tsx tests/crash-recovery.ts && tsx tests/container-smoke.ts
scripts.test:ci:ubuntu: tsx scripts/validate-tools.ts && tsx scripts/doctor.ts && tsx tests/test-extension.ts && tsx tests/container-smoke.ts
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm run validate:tools && npm publish
scripts.prepublish:npm: node -e "if(!process.env.NPM_TOKEN) throw new Error('NPM_TOKEN not set in .env')"
